CustomField.description: Id of a verified Organization-Wide Email Address (Setup → Organization-Wide Email Addresses) to send the failure notification from. Required whenever Send_Email_On_Failure__c is checked: without it, Messaging.sendEmail falls back to the running user's own address, which can throw INVALID_SENDER in a Batch/Queueable context where the running user has no deliverable email — so this must be set for the failure email to actually send.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Id of the Organization-Wide Email Address to send the failure notification from. Required if Send Email On Failure is checked — the email can fail to send without it.
CustomField.label: Org Wide Email Address Id
